root_cause.text: The `qdisc_dequeue_drop()` function incorrectly appends dropped packets to the child qdisc's local `to_free` list instead of the root qdisc's `to_free` list, preventing them from being freed by `qdisc_run_end()` which only processes the root qdisc.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `qdisc_dequeue_drop()` to retrieve the root qdisc via `qdisc_root_sleeping(q)` and append the packet to `root->to_free` (if `TCQ_F_DEQUEUE_DROPS` is set on the root) or free it directly, instead of unconditionally appending it to `q->to_free`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Delegate skb dequeue drop queueing to the root qdisc under RCU protection to ensure proper deferred freeing.
intent_record.what: Modified qdisc_dequeue_drop to retrieve the root sleeping qdisc under RCU protection and conditionally defer freeing the skb to the root's to_free list if the root has TCQ_F_DEQUEUE_DROPS set, otherwise freeing it immediately.
intent_record.how: Ensures skb drop handling is delegated to the root qdisc's free list when supported, preventing incorrect deferral on child qdiscs and ensuring safe memory reclamation under RCU.
